title: “Is Hate Lost in Translation?”: Evaluation of Multilingual LGBTQIA+ Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of zero-shot and fine-tuned GPT-3.5 models on classifying text as homotransphobic or non-homotransphobic using annotated LGBTQIA+ hate speech datasets.

Comparing the model's hate speech detection performance metrics (F1-score, Precision, Recall, Cohen's Kappa) across different languages (English, Italian, Chinese, and code-switched English-Tamil) and measuring the performance degradation caused by machine translation.
